title: National investment, Indonesian energy performance and IEA global context
interpretation: Source-dated reference indicators, NOT a live telemetry/API feed. Items are additive only within one source's own accounting classification, never between publishers. Existing canonical sector datasets remain the authoritative place for their originally charted time series.
licensing: BKPM open source requires attribution; IEA report CC BY 4.0, but downloadable IEA dataset has separate non-CC conditions. This module summarises attributed public report numbers; it does not redistribute the IEA spreadsheet.

bkpm.scope_note: LKPM aggregate PMA/PMDN investment realization; excludes upstream oil and gas and financial services per BKPM reporting footnotes. Sector KBLI classification cannot, without record-level isolation, prove realized investment at a named smelter, battery factory or AI data center. PMA source country ≠ ultimate beneficial owner.
bkpm.raw_import_status: Q2 dataset discovered; portal shows CSV download but file URL and row values were not directly retrievable in this integration. Do not invent sector/province figures. Published national KPIs come from BKPM's 17 July 2026 press release.

quarterly_kpis.label: National investment realized · H1 2026
quarterly_kpis.description: H1 total including PMA and PMDN; realization, not announced capex.

quarterly_kpis.label: National investment realized · Q2 2026
quarterly_kpis.description: Q2 2026 investment realization; part of H1 total, NOT additional to H1.

quarterly_kpis.label: National H1 realization growth
quarterly_kpis.description: Growth compared with H1 2025; not annual GDP or investment growth.

quarterly_kpis.label: Workers absorbed · H1 2026
quarterly_kpis.description: BKPM direct labour absorption from LKPM; not net economy-wide job creation.

quarterly_kpis.label: Workers absorbed · Q2 2026
quarterly_kpis.description: Included within H1 labour absorption; do not sum again.

bkpm.field_notes: Original Q2 2026 CKBP/LKPM sector, region and country records are linked as catalog; numeric breakdown cards appear only after verified raw downloads. Unit in dataset: investments Rp million and USD thousand, not rupiah trillion.

useful_sectors.channel: LKPM realisation, PMA/PMDN, province, origin and KBLI
useful_sectors.caveat: Link dataset; no invented sector totals.
BKPM's exclusion of upstream oil and gas prevents direct comparison with ESDM sector total.

useful_sectors.channel: Mining, metals, and refining industry KBLI exposure
useful_sectors.caveat: Published BKPM sector total ≠ verified realized capex of each smelter.

useful_sectors.channel: Information/communication, data centers and electricity supply exposure
useful_sectors.caveat: Standard KBLI categories ≠ audited standalone AI compute capex.

sources.title: BKPM Data Terbuka · Q2 2026 LKPM detailed dataset

items.label: Total ESDM sector investment
items.description: 2025 realized, status 31 Jan 2026; exact sector boundary includes upstream oil/gas.

items.label: Oil and natural gas investment
items.description: ESDM subsector realised 2025; covers upstream oil/gas that BKPM typically excludes.

items.label: Minerals AND coal investment
items.description: ESDM 2025 realised minerba aggregate, cannot isolate critical minerals without project/commodity evidence.

items.label: Electricity investment
items.description: ESDM 2025 sector electricity investment; investment capital is not generating capacity.

items.label: EBTKE investment
items.description: ESDM 2025 new/renewable energy and energy conservation; not identical to electricity-only investment.

items.label: National energy security index · provisional
items.description: ESDM 2025 preliminary score; classified 'Tahan'. 2025 scoring methodology changed, so historical scores cannot be plotted as directly comparable.

items.label: National electrification ratio
items.description: ESDM reported at end-2025; coverage does not measure reliability or service quality.

items.label: EBT share of primary energy mix
items.description: As of October 2025, NOT year-end 2025; annual EBTKE reporting uses another period and series.

items.label: SAIFI average annual interruptions
items.description: 2025 system average interruption frequency in energy-security chapter, not a province-specific metric.

items.label: Biodiesel manufacturing rated capacity
items.description: ESDM 2025 report describes 22.02 million kL/year installed nameplate after licensing expansion; not actual biodiesel output.

iea.title: IEA Global Energy Review 2026 · 2025 world observations

items.label: Global total energy demand growth
items.description: Demand increased ~8 EJ; world 2025, not Indonesia's demand growth.

items.label: Global electricity demand growth
items.description: Global electricity demand rose around 800 TWh in 2025; rounded estimate.

items.label: Global data centre electricity demand growth
items.description: 2025 demand growth from data centres worldwide, NOT Indonesia's AI GPU buildout or data centre grid MW.

items.label: Worldwide new renewable capacity
items.description: Approximately 800 GW annual renewable additions in 2025; solar ~75% of this; new capacity, not total cumulative fleet.

items.label: Global solar PV generation increase
items.description: Record 2025 annual solar generation increase; production energy, NOT new installed capacity.

items.label: World battery storage new capacity
items.description: Almost 110 GW annual 2025 battery storage additions; power capacity, NOT GW-hours energy capacity.

items.label: Electric car sales globally
items.description: More than 20 million new electric cars sold in 2025; presented as >20m lower bound rather than exact 20m.

items.label: Global coal consumption growth
items.description: Global coal demand, not Indonesian production or exports.

items.label: World oil demand growth
items.description: Incremental global demand increase over 2024, NOT absolute consumption.

items.label: Energy-related global CO2 change
items.description: 2025 global energy-related carbon dioxide emissions growth, not Indonesian territorial inventory.
